summary: Jason is an experienced pre-sales engineer in Austin who is the technical half of most US deals. He builds good scripted API demos but they run from his laptop, not in a pipeline. Commercial credit sits with the account executives; he holds a minority share on each deal.
archetype: Overlay SE with real API skills used for demos, not QA

skills.why: Maintains a reviewed Postman collection with assertions and failure cases; runs it manually before calls, no CI, no defects found before release.
Maps customer needs to the product and scopes POCs alone, with a technical-win record; does not coach AEs on discovery.
Writes notes and a technical-win flag on deals owned by others; stages, forecast and amounts belong to the AEs.
Clear runnable procedures that a PMM reviewed and fixed; no user validation results.
A completed course and one short helper script in a demo page; nothing production.
Foundational exam only; his Rackspace work was years ago and nothing here uses AWS.
Pre-sales stops at signature; implementation is CS.

decoys.why: Listed on CV, MySQL tickets from 2016-2019; no recent trace.
Support tickets at a previous employer many years ago.

traps.plant: Every opportunity lists him as overlay SE with 15-30% credit; two are the same opportunities that appear on the Mumbai AE's record (P022).
Postman collection and Newman runs support demos and POC validation; a QA-style 'API testing' mapping overstates the engineering practice.
Cloud Practitioner badge, verified and current, with a CV listing AWS as a skill.
K3 exact-level skills; HCM self-rating 3 on selling and API testing, 2 on Salesforce.

answer_behavior.notes: Fast, direct replies; accepts one level up on API testing.
